$comment: Pre-approved commands for the coverage loop. Without these, every tick
stalls on a permission prompt and the loop is not autonomous -- which is
the whole point of it. Each entry matches the exact command form written
in AGENTS.md section 5; if you change a command there, change it here.
Deliberately NOT allowed: writes to the logs folder, arbitrary Edit of
the config (Worker C has no Edit tool and must go through config_edit.py),
rm, and git. Those stay prompted.
Path rules use Edit(...), not Write(...) -- only Edit rules are matched by
file permission checks, and an Edit rule covers every file-editing tool.
A Write(...) deny rule looks right and silently does nothing.
NONE OF THIS APPLIES UNTIL THE WORKSPACE IS TRUSTED. Open this folder in
VS Code once and accept the trust dialog; until you do, Claude Code ignores
every entry here and the loop stalls on its first command. preflight.py
